title: Moscow faces mass drone strike overnight, flights grounded at major airports
summary: According to the mayor, over 100 drones have been shot down en route to Moscow during the night thus far.

title: Estonia to build 150 bunkers along Russian border
summary: In response to an increase in Russian aggression in the region, the Baltic states have placed a strong emphasis on strategic readiness in recent years, encouraging civilian preparedness and ramping up defense spending.

title: Russia restarts grain shipments through Sea of Azov, media reports
summary: Kyiv's military campaign resulted in over 100 Russian vessels being hit in the Azov sea during the summer — negatively impacting Russia's economy and contributing to an increase in global grain prices.

title: Pentagon watchdog rejects bipartisan plea to investigate Starlink disruption, AP reports
summary: The refusal is interpreted by sources familiar with the matter as a way to avoid investigating Elon Musk and Starlink, AP reported.

title: Canadian volunteer killed by Russian drone while rescuing animals in Donetsk Oblast
summary: Jesse Adams, founder of the Canadian organization RainCoast Dog Rescue Society, was killed by a Russian FPV drone while evacuating animals from front-line Kramatorsk.
